newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israelis kill two guerrillas in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israelis kill two guerrillas in south Lebanon.

text.p: Hizbollah guerrillas ambushed Israeli troops in a convoy of cars in south Lebanon on Saturday but the Israelis fought back and killed two guerrillas, pro-Israeli secuirty sources said.
There were no Israeli casualties or injuries in the incident, the sources said.

Guerrillas firing machineguns and throwing hand grenades attacked three civilian cars with Israeli troops in them near the village of Rihan in the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the sources said.
One of the Israelis in the convoy was an officer named Elie Amitay, commander of the western sector of the border zone, they added.
Hizbollah officials in Beirut were not immediately able to confirm that an attack took place or that the pro-Iranian movement suffered casualties.
